artifacts.notes: Complete Homily LIX on Matthew. Complete historical text within the page, including article/chapter headings; site navigation, ads, biography links, copyright and editorial wrapper omitted. Not collated against print.
artifacts.rights_basis: The 1888 English translation predates 1931 and is public domain in the United States. Historical prose only is retained, with modern New Advent wrapper excluded; no exclusive rights in the historical wording are claimed.

edition.publication: Historical English translation published 1888, as identified in the New Advent footer; exact web witness acquired 29 September 2026
edition.title: Homilies on Matthew, Prevost translation revised by Riddle
translators: George Prevost; revised by M. B. Riddle

alternate_titles: Homilies on the Gospel of Saint Matthew
work.author: John Chrysostom
work.description: Chrysostom's ninety homilies on Matthew, preached at Antioch in the 390s and addressed by homily number and, where an edition supplies them, by numbered section within the homily. Section division and numbering are editorial and vary between editions and translations.
work.title: Homiliae in Matthaeum
